name: ker_coprod_of_disjoint_range
statement: Type*} [AddCommGroup M₂] [Module R M₂] {M₃ : Type*} [AddCommGroup M₃] [Module R M₃] (f : M →ₗ[R] M₃) (g : M₂ →ₗ[R] M₃) (hd : Disjoint (range f) (range g)) : ker (f.coprod g) = (ker f).prod (ker g)

name: prod_le_iff
statement: Submodule R M} {p₂ : Submodule R M₂} {q : Submodule R (M × M₂)} : p₁.prod p₂ ≤ q ↔ map (LinearMap.inl R M M₂) p₁ ≤ q ∧ map (LinearMap.inr R M M₂) p₂ ≤ q

have_tree.type: y - x ∈ ker f ⊔ ker g
